subject.title: Interactive parity with the Codex runtime: ask-user-question · plan mode · goal mode — the roadmap

question: Should OpenClaw accept Codex-style structured questions, plan mode, and goal mode as core runtime features now, and should the paired implementation land as one branch or be split?
rationale: The request adds cross-surface core behavior, protocol/API changes, UI/channel rendering, new config surface, and goal-driver semantics, so maintainer product and ownership intent is required before implementation can be considered done.

options.title: Split staged PRs
options.body: Keep this hub open and ask for staged review of the question pipeline, plan mode, and goal driver with focused proof for each surface.

options.title: Sponsor full branch
options.body: A maintainer can explicitly accept the broad review cost and resolve proof, rollout, and API concerns on the paired implementation branch.

options.title: Defer or narrow
options.body: Maintainers can reject or narrow the roadmap if these primitives should wait or move behind a smaller plugin/API design first.

recommendation.title: Split staged PRs
recommendation.body: Keep this hub open and ask for staged review of the question pipeline, plan mode, and goal driver with focused proof for each surface.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest feature-history signal across the existing update_plan, strict-agentic, and session-goal foundations that this roadmap extends.
